_doc: One panel pick-and-place, shaped after the X1Exc state machine and aimed at the firmware's own frames.
Single source for scripts/animate_cycle.py (authors USD drive targets) and scripts/camera_study.py / optimize_cameras.py (score sensor mounts over the same poses).
Angles in degrees, firmware joint convention (== URDF: boom -69..-31 up-negative, arm 31..155 in-positive).
home: tool raised in front of the machine, house square (Positioning/Raise+Swing end with swing ~0).

approach -> contact: contact_surface onto panel_pick_approach_link then panel_top_link (firmware panelTopWithMargin / panelTop), tool Z along the fork blade. Solved to 0.2 mm; ~3 deg of normal error is the out-of-plane part a 3 deg swing introduces with tilt/rotator at 0.

lift clear: output link 1.98 m and tool 0.95 m above the chassis origin, past the firmware's Placing gates OutpLinkHgtToClearPanelStack = 1.0 and ToolHgtForSwingInChs = 0.7/0.8 (SysPar.m:264, :274; MdlApp.c:13060).
hover -> set down: tool Z up onto the working row at (4.712, 4.5, -0.207), solved to 0.1 mm.

Solved by planar IK over the URDF in build/ (boom/arm/bucket share the Y axis, so tool pitch fixes bucket and position is a 2-D search). Regenerate if the geometry or limits change: animate_cycle.py refuses keyframes outside the limits in the USD.

windows._doc: Segment s runs keyframes[s] -> keyframes[s+1]. A target is scored only inside the segments where it has to be seen.
